title: The First Form Line: Name
label: ch:pa-form-name
canDo: I can recognise the Gurmukhi name label, select between two separately practised values, and fill one requested name line from a nonverbal cue with no model.

payoff.summary: The learner fills one name field from a nonverbal identity cue after the label, both values, selection, supported entry, delayed entry, spelling, spacing, and repair have each received a bounded pass.
